guidance.heading: Updated 2026 Outlook
section: •Adjusted sales growth of approximately 6% compared to 7% to 8% previously
•Adjusted operating income margin of approximately 14.9%, unchanged compared to prior outlook
•Adjusted EPS of $2.90 to $2.95, reflecting 16% to 18% growth, compared to $2.94 to $3.00 previously

Matt Reintjes, Chair of the Board, President, and Chief Executive Officer, commented, “YETI delivered Q3 adjusted sales growth of more than 6%, reflecting the increasing breadth and balance of our growing global business, with Drinkware up 8% and international up 19%. Strong operating discipline drove margin expansion, with profits growing significantly faster than sales. Our continued strong free cash flow generation supported our long-term growth plans while also returning capital through share repurchases.

This performance demonstrates continued progress against our Investor Day “Built for the Wild” strategy. It reflects the dedication of our teams and partners, and the multi-year investments we have made across brand, innovation, and global capabilities. Together, these results reinforce the strength of the financial model we outlined. While demand was uneven at times during the quarter, particularly in the US and Canadian markets, the expanding diversity of our products, channels, and geographies strongly supported our overall performance. Looking ahead, we anticipate the consumer environment will remain cautious and put pressure on demand in Q4. Although we are mindful of these near-term dynamics, the strength of our strategy, the durability of our brand, our innovation cadence, and our business model position us well to navigate the short-term market, create value and continue building for the long term.”

Mr. Reintjes continued, “Across our product portfolio, we are strengthening the iconic product platforms that built YETI while also driving our portfolio expansion as you have seen in the past few weeks. At the same time, our brand continues to grow in reach and relevance through authentic storytelling, partnerships, and community engagement around the world. For both product and brand, international remains an especially compelling opportunity. We are seeing continued momentum across Europe and Asia with our first brand stores opening in Japan and Korea and our initial marketplace launch in China in the past few weeks. As we scale, we are also strengthening the capabilities behind the business, across innovation, supply chain, customization, digital, and go-to-market execution.”
